scoring_justification: DFT bandgaps and bowing are reported directly; a verifier cannot rerun the expensive DFT calculations. Comparing reported values to paper-reported DFT data extracted from Fig. 4(b) is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold for DFT bandgaps and bowing parameter
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 4(b) of Tongay et al., Appl. Phys. Lett. 104, 012101 (2014). The paper reports DFT-calculated bandgaps for monolayer Mo1-xWxSe2 at compositions x=0,0.14,0.75,1 and the derived bowing parameter.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The figure was digitized by the task setter to extract the central bandgap values and the bowing parameter reported in the paper's DFT section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond to the paper's own DFT results; they are not invented synthetic numbers.

outputs.description: Computed direct bandgap (eV) for each composition (x=0, 0.14, 0.75, 1) of monolayer Mo1-xWxSe2.
Fitted bowing parameter b (in eV) derived from the bandgap bowing equation.

output_contract.notes: Only the DFT bandgaps and derived bowing parameter are scored; experimental synthesis/characterization are excluded. The checker will also verify monotonic bandgap increase with x and a positive bowing parameter.
